subject: Can I use pcountOpen for my analysis?

messages.author: c05fcdc4ef96c903
messages.subject: Can I use pcountOpen for my analysis?
parts:
Hi,

I have 11 years of bird survey data. Under these surveys, observers drove along 30 mile long fixed transects and recorded count of what they saw whenever they saw it. Now I am trying to estimate both occupancy and abundance using these survey data. 

For occupancy, I am thinking of dividing each 30 mile routes into 10, 3 mile routes which will give me 10 replicates and I will use function "occu" under unmarked package. I believe this should work. But I will really appreciate if anyone has any opinion about this.

I am clear about estimating abundance. Since surveys are just done once every year, the closed population assumption does not apply here. So this is clearly a open population problem, with J (number of times a survey was conducted every year) =1. So this will come under open population abundance estimate without robust design, so Dail and Madsen 2012 should be used here. Am I correct so far? And if yes, can I still use pcountOpen for this and make primary period under unmarkedFramePCO =1?
Also to avoid dependence and keep replicates independent, I am breaking each 30 mile route into 3 mile routes with a gap of 1 route in between. Does that make sense?

I will be really grateful, if anyone can provide any opinion, suggest any solution.

Looking forward to replies.

Thanks,
Sprih
